sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [C]I need the prayers of those I love, While trav'ling [G]o'er life's rugged way,
[G]That I may true [C]and faithful be, And live for Jesus every day.
[C]I want [G]my friends to pray for me, To bear my tempted soul [C]a-bove,
[C]And intercede [F]with God for me; I [C]need the prayers of those I love.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [C]I want my friends to pray [G]for me,
[G]I need the prayers of those [C]I love.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [C]I need the prayers of those [G]I love,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [C]I want my friends to pray [G]for me,
[G]To hold [C]me up on wing of faith,
